banner.title: multus
banner.tagline: Gives selected home-automation pods a second network interface on the IoT VLAN, while every pod keeps its Cilium interface.

explainer.title: A second interface, chosen per pod

steps.title: Attach
steps.text: A pod names the multus-iot network in its annotation. Multus adds the interface, leaving eth0 on Cilium.
steps.scene: a pod block with a second cable plugged into its side

steps.title: Macvlan
steps.text: The macvlan plugin puts net1 directly on bond0.3, so the pod has an address on the IoT VLAN.
steps.scene: a VLAN bus with a branch into the pod

steps.title: Address
steps.text: Static IPAM assigns the address from the pod annotation. The default route goes to the IoT gateway.
steps.scene: a blank address tag hanging from a route arrow, no readable text

steps.title: Return path
steps.text: The sbr plugin keeps replies leaving on the interface they arrived on, so both networks stay reachable.
steps.scene: two paths looping back on themselves

art.about: how Multus attaches a second network to a pod
art.title: How Multus adds a second interface
